path.founder_idea.title: I have an idea
path.founder_idea.description: You know what you want to build. You'll describe the idea, name the project and go straight to checking whether it makes sense.
path.founder_idea.outcome: You start with the Idea Stage
path.founder_no_idea.title: I want to build something but don't know what

path.joiner.title: I want to join someone
path.joiner.description: You'll fill in your profile and land in Social, where you'll find teams looking for people — or they'll find you.
